result.quote: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
result.reason: The key is supported: Zebul’s message alerted Abimelech that Gaal was stirring up the city against him. However, “Why” can also defensibly ask for Zebul’s motivation—he had heard Gaal’s words and become angry. The question should specify whether it asks for his purpose in sending the messengers or his reason for doing so.
